title: Wall panel layout, version 2
description: What one panel shows: pages of cards. Shared by the Android app, the ESP32 firmware and the management add-on; it never carries credentials. Which cards exist, what entities, sizes and options each accepts, is defined in cards.json and checked by the add-on on save.

schema.description: Layout format. Files without it are version 1 (tiles) and are migrated on read.

version.description: Layout revision. The add-on increments it on every change; a panel only applies a layout newer than the one it holds.

panel.description: Display settings. They move to the panel configuration (config.schema.json) in phase B; until then the panel reads them here.

id.description: Unique in the layout. Stays the same when the card is edited, moved or resized.

card.description: Card type from cards.json, as kind.variant (e.g. light.dimmer).

entities.description: Home Assistant entity ids. How many, and of which domains, depends on the card type.

size.description: Grid cells, columns x rows. Omitted: the card type's default size.

confirm.description: Ask before sending the command. Defaults to true for lock cards.

options.description: Card type options, as defined in cards.json.

icon.description: Material Design Icons name, as in Home Assistant (e.g. mdi:lightbulb).
